title: German authorities took custody on Oct 2 of a 28-year-old Russian national detained in Osaka, suspected of involvement in Qilin ransomware.
content_md:
German authorities took custody on Oct 2 of a 28-year-old Russian national detained in Osaka, suspected of involvement in Qilin ransomware. 

via Mastodon https://cyberworldops.eu/en/qilin-case-crosses-borders-as-germany-takes-custody-of-russian-suspect
